scope: Static preflight of unexecuted V11 runner and draft worksheet while V8 source producer is running. No source/runtime mutation or assumption of V8 result.

findings.issue: Worksheet T14 cut not explicitly enforced
findings.detail: Runner checks the two V8 source_heads equal each other but does not assert they equal worksheet’s exact T14 program cut 3c348bd913e97580952e39295057ce2c027b4b2a / 6533be7d665988e38e0b8c80a1f7f3e1362b713d. Rehashing program files supports byte equality but does not establish the specified exact provenance cut.
findings.fix: Compare both receipt source_heads to the explicit T14 codecut before launch; later metadata-only owner HEAD may differ and should remain separately recorded.

findings.issue: Retained full report self-consistency not directly checked
findings.detail: The runner checks each stdout_report result and line but not exact passed case IDs, per-case statuses, g11 claim or source_commit-to-source_heads relationship. Trusted producer normally produces those, but the worksheet promises full reports pass.
findings.fix: Require both expected source regression case IDs exactly once with pass, report g11_claim not-passed and report source_commit equal the line’s corresponding source_heads entry.

other_observations: Expected scope from actual profile and explicit producer/factory/profile paths is 182 (131 21.x, 51 main); source-input rows must be unique and exact and are rehashed independently for both receipts.

Pinned unprofiled Node, original 1800/4096 limits, fresh output, environment sanitization, process group timeout kill/reap, retained malformed report and snapshot errors, and fail-closed actual full owner report success criteria are present. V10 timeout and exact canonical prestate checked.

No independent V8 pass is asserted; both V8 receipts and genuine full current source runs remain required. Capture final metadata-only preparation heads separately and confirm program bytes still match gates.
Pre-launch validation failure and unexpected external interruption are not guaranteed a terminal receipt; no hostile concurrent-filesystem or complete external input binding claim.
